thread.title: Apple Stokes Artificial Intelligence Talent Battle With Google Hire

author: REINHARDT KRAUSE
title: Apple Stokes Artificial Intelligence Talent Battle With Google Hire
text:
Apple ( AAPL ) aims to catch-up in artificial intelligence as it has hired away the former head of AI and search technology from Google-parent Alphabet ( GOOGL ).
X John Giannandrea will report directly to Apple Chief Executive Tim Cook, according to the New York Times . Apple's voice-activated Siri search tools lag that of Amazon.com 's ( AMZN ) Alexa as well as Google's digital assistant in consumer applications.
Apple's move is the latest example of tech giants luring away top AI talent. The companies are rushing to improve a wide range of existing products with AI tools. AI programs — essentially computer algorithms — analyze huge amounts of data to identify patterns and predict outcomes.
Amazon and Google lead on sales of smart home devices, though Apple still dominates the smartphone market. The digital assistants can help with shopping, entertainment, school work and other tasks. Apple was up 1.9% to close at 171.61 Alphabet gained 1.1% to 1,029.71. Amazon climbed 1.3% to 1,410.57.
IBD Microsoft ( MSFT ) is another top AI stock to watch . Microsoft last week reorganized to establish two main divisions. One of them focuses on both cloud computing and AI.
China's tech giants, meanwhile, have stepped up AI hiring. Microsoft's former executive vice president and top AI engineer, Qi Lu, is now Baidu's chief operating officer. Andrew Ng, formerly the founder of the Google Brain deep learning project, left as Baidu's chief scientist last year and now runs a venture capital fund focused on AI startups.
